name: Gemcitabine (monotherapy)
cyclesNote: First cycle is weekly for 7 of 8 weeks in some schedules; thereafter days 1, 8 and 15 of a 28-day cycle. Continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity. For reduced-fitness / poor performance-status patients (locally advanced or metastatic).

institution.provenance: ONCOTREE grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: Single-agent gemcitabine is not biomarker-restricted; it is the reduced-fitness backbone when a doublet or triplet is not tolerable.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: moderate emetic risk; give guideline-tier antiemetic prophylaxis before gemcitabine.

supportiveCare: Monitor for myelosuppression; hold on a treatment day for cytopenias.
Watch for gemcitabine flu-like symptoms, transaminitis, and rare pneumonitis / haemolytic-uraemic syndrome.
Prioritise symptom control, biliary/GI patency, nutrition and pancreatic enzyme replacement.
monitoring: liver and renal function before each cycle
CA 19-9 and imaging to assess response

doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Hold day 8 or 15 for neutropenia or thrombocytopenia and reduce at the next cycle per protocol. Physician decides.

drugs.name: Gemcitabine
drugs.notes: Gemcitabine 1,000 mg/m2 IV on days 1, 8 and 15 of a 28-day cycle (weekly x7 of 8 in the first cycle in some schedules). Source: single-agent standard of care per NCCN Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma / DeVita general reference (own wording).
